About

Communications professional.
Occasional comedian.

I'm a communications and content professional with a decade of experience across defence, higher education, legal, government, and membership organisations. I write well, think strategically, and move fast without dropping the ball.

I'm also a two-time RAW Comedy State Finalist, former MC, and former radio host. The ability to read a room, hold attention, and land a message isn't a party trick — it's exactly what good communications work requires.

Known as a culture hire. I'm usually the resident public speaker, AV guy, DJ, or the person everyone debriefs with after the meeting.
